verificationLevels.official: Steps taken from the company's own help pages.
verificationLevels.partial: An official page was found but it doesn't cover every step, or sources disagree.
verificationLevels.unverified: No official page was reachable. Only the general routes are given.

services.name: Netflix
steps: Sign in to Netflix and open the Manage your membership page.
Select Cancel.
Select Finish cancellation. A confirmation email follows.
notes: You keep access until the end of the billing period.
Signing out or deleting the app does not cancel anything.
If there's no Cancel button, Netflix is billed through a partner such as a telecom or app store. Cancel there.

services.name: Amazon Prime
steps: Go to Your Account, then Prime membership.
Select End membership.
Follow the on-screen steps.
notes: Annual plans are refunded in full only if you haven't made eligible purchases or used Prime benefits since the latest charge. Monthly plans follow the same rule.
If you joined through Google Play, cancel under Subscriptions in Google Play.
A membership bought through a banking or payment app (Bharat Connect) can't be cancelled and isn't refundable.

services.name: JioHotstar (Disney+ Hotstar, JioCinema)
steps: Open the JioHotstar app or website and look in your account or profile for a subscription, membership or billing section.
If you see a cancel or turn off auto-renewal option, use it and keep the confirmation email.
If you can't find one, stop the payment itself. Cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction (see the general guides on this page).
notes: We couldn't reach an official JioHotstar help page, so we can't confirm the in-app steps.
If you paid through Google Play or the App Store, cancel in that store's subscription settings.
Be careful with support phone numbers on third-party sites. Use only the ones inside the official app.

services.name: Spotify
steps: Go to your Spotify account page and open Manage your plan.
Select Cancel subscription.
Check that the account page shows the date your plan changes to Free.
notes: Premium stays until your next billing date.
On Family and Duo plans only the plan manager can cancel. A member who follows these steps just leaves the plan.
If a mobile provider or Apple bills you, cancel with them.

services.name: YouTube Premium
steps: On a computer, open youtube.com/paid_memberships and choose Manage membership, then Deactivate.
On a phone, tap your profile picture, open Paid memberships, pick the membership and follow the cancel prompts.
Choose a reason and confirm.
notes: Benefits continue to the end of the billing cycle. Refunds for the unused part are generally not given.
If Apple bills you, cancel in your Apple account. If Google Play bills you, cancel in Google Play.
Annual plans can't be paused.

services.name: Google One
steps: On Android, open the Google One app, tap Menu, then Settings, then Cancel membership, and confirm.
On a computer, open Google One, click Settings, then Cancel membership, and confirm.
notes: Your files are not deleted, but you drop back to the free 15 GB. Going over it can limit sending and receiving email.
Benefits last until the end of the billing period.
If you bought through the App Store or a carrier, cancel there.

services.name: Apple (iCloud+, App Store subscriptions)
steps: Open Settings on your iPhone and tap your name.
Tap Subscriptions and select the one you want to stop.
Tap Cancel Subscription. You may need to scroll down to find it.
notes: If you can't find it, check your Apple receipt to see which Apple Account was charged.
A family member's subscription can only be cancelled by that family member.
Carrier billed subscriptions are cancelled with the carrier.

services.name: Google Play subscriptions
steps: Open the Google Play app and go to Subscriptions.
Select the subscription and tap Cancel.
Or open play.google.com on a computer and click Manage next to the subscription.
notes: Uninstalling the app does not cancel the subscription.
You keep access for the time you've already paid.
Some apps let you pause instead of cancel.

services.name: ZEE5
steps: In the Android app, tap Profile, then Control Center, then Plans & Rentals, then Manage Subscription, then Cancel Subscription.
On the website, open Profile, then Control Center, then Account Management, then My Subscription, and choose Cancel Renewal.
On iPhone, cancel in Settings under your Apple ID and Subscriptions.
notes: Cancellation applies at the end of the current billing cycle.
If you pay by UPI autopay, ZEE5 suggests pausing the mandate rather than cancelling it, because cancelling it switches your service off until you reactivate.
Deleting your account while a plan is active ends access without a refund.

services.name: SonyLIV
steps: If you paid by card, UPI or wallet, open My Purchases and click Cancel.
Pick a reason and submit.
If you paid through Google Play, Apple or Amazon, cancel in that store's subscription settings.
notes: On telecom billing in India, SonyLIV's help page says to send an SMS with STOP to 155223 and follow the reply.
You won't be charged for the next cycle and you can use the pack until the current one ends. There's no refund for partly used periods.

services.name: Jio (JioAutoPay, plan add-ons)
steps: To stop JioAutoPay, open MyJio and look in the JioPay section.
To drop a bundled OTT app, change to a plan with fewer apps: MyJio, then Plan details, then Change plan. You can change a plan once per billing cycle.
notes: We found Jio's AutoPay page but couldn't confirm a step by step path for cancelling a single add-on.
Amazon Prime bundled with some postpaid plans: Jio says to write to care@jio.com to cancel it.
You can also cancel the UPI mandate in your UPI app.

services.name: Airtel (Airtel Thanks AutoPay)
steps: Open the Airtel Thanks app and go to the Manage tab.
Pick the service, open its Autopay option and disable it.
Or use Payment Settings, then AutoPay, then Deactivate.
notes: Airtel's own pages don't agree on the exact menu names, so follow what you see in the app.
Only the person who turned autopay on can turn it off.
If a mandate remains, cancel it in your UPI app or ask your bank to block it.

services.name: Vi (Vi Movies & TV, value added services)
steps: For Vi Movies & TV, open the Vi app, tap your plan and scroll to the bottom of the base plan page.
Under Active Services tap Manage and use Stop auto renewal.
For value added services, open Vi App, then Help & Support, and search for VAS.
notes: Vi lists 155223 for VAS deactivation. Its pages disagree on the SMS number (155223 or 321), so check the app before sending.
Signing out of the Vi Movies & TV app does not cancel anything.

services.name: Swiggy One
steps: Open the Swiggy app and look for Swiggy One in your account.
If you see a way to turn off auto-renewal, use it.
If not, stop the payment: cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction.
notes: Swiggy's terms say a membership can't be cancelled during its paid period. Some guides describe turning off auto-renewal in the app, but we couldn't confirm that on an official page.
A Swiggy One membership that came free with a bank card can't be cancelled either.
After you stop it, benefits usually stay until the paid period ends.

services.name: Zomato Gold
steps: Open the Zomato app or website and look in your account or profile for a subscription, membership or billing section.
If you see a cancel or turn off auto-renewal option, use it and keep the confirmation email.
If you can't find one, stop the payment itself. Cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction (see the general guides on this page).
notes: We couldn't find an official Zomato help page for cancelling Gold, so we can't confirm the in-app steps.

services.name: cult.fit (cultpass)
steps: Open the Tata Neu app and go to Fitness.
Open the menu and your profile, then Active packs/subscriptions.
Select the cult subscription, tap the three dots and choose cancel subscription.
notes: This is a 2022 article about the ELITE monthly plan. Other plans may differ.
Cancelling stops next month's renewal and you keep access until the billing date.
Pausing is another option: open Active Packs in the app, pick the pack and tap pause.

services.name: Microsoft 365
steps: Sign in at account.microsoft.com/services with the account you bought it on.
Find the subscription and select Manage.
Select Turn off recurring billing to stop future charges and keep access until the expiry date, or select Cancel subscription.
notes: If you bought through Apple, Google Play or a retailer, they manage the billing. Contact them.
You can cancel a free trial within 30 days and won't be charged.

services.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
steps: Sign in at account.adobe.com/plans and select Manage plan.
Select Cancel your plan and then Continue to cancel.
Pick a reason, select Continue, then Confirm cancellation.
notes: Most plans give a full refund within 14 days of purchase.
After that, an annual plan billed monthly can carry a cancellation fee of 50% of the remaining contract. Annual prepaid plans aren't refunded.
Plans bought through Apple, Google or Microsoft are cancelled there.

services.name: Canva
steps: Log in to the right Canva account and open Settings from your profile menu.
Open Billing and select Cancel plan, then Continue cancellation.
Pick a reason if you want to and select Cancel subscription.
notes: You can pause a Pro, Teams or Business plan for up to 3 months instead.
Plans bought in Google Play or the App Store can't be cancelled inside Canva. Cancel in that store.
If you change your mind, use Stay on your plan on the Billing page while it's still active.

services.name: ChatGPT
steps: Sign in to ChatGPT and open Settings from your account menu.
Select Billing.
Under Cancel plan, select Cancel.
notes: Cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date.
If you subscribed through Apple or Google Play, cancel there. Uninstalling the app does not cancel anything.
Cancelling stops renewals but doesn't refund earlier charges.

services.name: LinkedIn Premium
steps: On desktop, open the Me menu, then Premium features, then Manage subscription.
Choose Cancel subscription and follow the prompts.
On the app, tap your profile photo, then Premium features, then Manage subscription, then Cancel subscription.
notes: Premium stays active to the end of the billing period. Cancel at least a day before the next billing date.
Subscriptions bought on an Apple device are cancelled in Apple's subscription settings.
Some plans can be refunded within seven days of a charge if you didn't use Premium.

services.name: Times Prime
steps: Open the Times Prime app or website and look in your account or profile for a subscription, membership or billing section.
If you see a cancel or turn off auto-renewal option, use it and keep the confirmation email.
If you can't find one, stop the payment itself. Cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction (see the general guides on this page).
notes: We couldn't reach an official Times Prime help page from our research tool, so we can't confirm the cancel steps.

services.name: The Hindu
steps: Open the The Hindu app or website and look in your account or profile for a subscription, membership or billing section.
If you see a cancel or turn off auto-renewal option, use it and keep the confirmation email.
If you can't find one, stop the payment itself. Cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction (see the general guides on this page).
notes: We couldn't reach an official help page for The Hindu from our research tool, so we can't confirm the cancel steps.

services.name: Audible
steps: Sign in to Audible on a desktop browser.
Open your username menu and go to your membership details.
Choose to cancel and confirm. A confirmation email follows.
notes: Unused credits expire when you cancel. Books you bought with credits stay in your library.
You can pause once every 12 months for up to 90 days instead.
If you subscribed through an app store, cancel there.

services.name: Tata Play
steps: Open the Tata Play app or tataplay.com and go to Manage Pack.
Drop the pack or Binge combo before the renewal date.
notes: Binge combos renew monthly from your account balance, so dropping the pack before renewal stops that charge.
We couldn't find a page on turning off autopay or auto recharge. Ask customer care, or cancel the mandate in your UPI app or bank.
Cancelling the Secure+ camera subscription is done by calling customer care.

services.name: Dropbox
steps: Log in at dropbox.com and open the account menu from your avatar at the bottom left.
Choose Manage account and scroll to Cancel plan.
Pick a reason and confirm.
notes: Your account moves to Dropbox Basic (2 GB) at the end of the billing cycle.
If you bought on a phone or tablet there's no Cancel plan button. Cancel in the app store.

services.name: JioSaavn
steps: If you subscribed through Google Play, open Google Play, go to My Subscriptions, pick Saavn and tap Cancel Subscription.
If you subscribed through Apple, open Settings, then your Apple ID, then Subscriptions, pick Saavn and tap Cancel Subscription.
notes: JioSaavn's official pages only cover the Google Play and Apple routes.
You can use Pro until the end of the current billing period.

services.name: Gaana
steps: Open the Gaana app or website and look in your account or profile for a subscription, membership or billing section.
If you see a cancel or turn off auto-renewal option, use it and keep the confirmation email.
If you can't find one, stop the payment itself. Cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction (see the general guides on this page).
notes: We couldn't find an official Gaana help page. Many users report that turning off auto-renew in the app didn't always stop charges, so also cancel the mandate with your bank or UPI app.
Email Gaana support in writing before the renewal date and keep the reply.

services.name: Hungama
steps: Open the Hungama app or website and look in your account or profile for a subscription, membership or billing section.
If you see a cancel or turn off auto-renewal option, use it and keep the confirmation email.
If you can't find one, stop the payment itself. Cancel the UPI autopay mandate or the card standing instruction (see the general guides on this page).
notes: We couldn't find an official Hungama help page. Third-party guides say to cancel from your account settings on hungama.com.
Check your bank or UPI app afterwards to make sure no mandate is left.

services.name: Notion
steps: In the sidebar, click Settings, then Billing, then Change plan.
Select the Free plan and click Continue.
Give feedback if asked and click Downgrade.
notes: The downgrade takes effect at the end of your billing cycle.
Moving to Free can limit blocks, version history and guests.
If you bought through the Apple App Store, cancel with Apple.

upiAutopay.title: Stop a UPI autopay mandate

apps.name: Google Pay
steps: Open the app and tap your profile picture.
Select Autopay and open the Live tab.
Tap the mandate and choose pause or cancel. Confirm with your UPI PIN.

apps.name: PhonePe
steps: Open your PhonePe profile and go to Autopay Settings.
Select the mandate.
Revoke it. Blocked funds are released straight away.

apps.name: Paytm
steps: Tap your profile icon and open UPI & Payment Settings.
Open Automatic Payments and pick the mandate.
Choose Cancel and confirm with your UPI PIN.

apps.name: Any other UPI app or your bank app
steps: Look for Autopay, Mandates or Automatic payments in the menu.
Open the mandate and revoke or cancel it.

notes: Cancelling the mandate stops the payments. It doesn't always cancel the service. Some services stop working, others send a bill.
A mandate attached to a loan, EMI or credit line can't always be cancelled in a UPI app. Contact the merchant or lender.
You get a notice about 24 hours before each debit. That's your window to cancel.
Uninstalling your UPI app does not cancel mandates.
If you gave up a phone number, mandates linked to it can keep running. Contact the merchants to revoke them.
NPCI points to upihelp.npci.org.in for questions about UPI mandates.

cardStandingInstruction.title: Stop a card standing instruction (recurring card payment)
steps: Find the pre-debit message from your bank. It has a link to opt out of that debit or the whole mandate.
Or use your bank's NetBanking or app. Look for e-mandates, standing instructions or autopay under your cards.
Or call your card issuer and ask them to withdraw the e-mandate.

banks.name: HDFC Bank
steps: Log in to NetBanking and open Credit Cards.
Open the Request menu and choose Autopay De-Register.
Select the card and click Continue to cancel.

banks.name: Axis Bank
steps: Open SIHUB (sihub.in/managesi/axisbank) or Mandate HQ (axis.mandatehq.com).
Enter your card details and the OTP sent to your registered mobile.
Open the listed mandate and cancel it.

notes: RBI's e-mandate rules require your card issuer to give you a way to withdraw a recurring mandate at any time.
A debit that was already notified before you cancelled can still go through.
Recurring debits above Rs 15,000 need extra authentication, but most subscriptions are below that.
We only found verified steps for HDFC Bank and Axis Bank. For other issuers use the general steps above.

downloadStatement.title: Get a CSV or Excel statement from your bank

banks.name: HDFC Bank
steps: Log in to NetBanking and go to Accounts, then Account Statement.
Pick the account and the period.
Choose Download. Excel and Delimited are offered next to PDF.
banks.note: Email delivery is PDF only. Delimited is the closest to CSV.

banks.name: State Bank of India
steps: Log in to OnlineSBI or YONO and open your account statement.
Look for a download format option and choose CSV or Excel if you see one.
banks.note: We couldn't find an official page for SBI's export formats.

banks.name: ICICI Bank
steps: Log in to Net Banking and go to Bank Accounts, then View Detailed Statement.
Pick the period and continue.
Download as CSV if the format option is shown.
banks.note: ICICI's help says savings e-statements come as password protected PDFs. Its Net Banking page lists the detailed statement as downloadable in PDF and CSV.

banks.name: Axis Bank
steps: Log in to Internet Banking and go to Accounts, then View Detailed Statement.
Pick the account and the duration, then click Get Statement.
For credit cards: Snapshot, Credit Cards, pick the card, View Statement, then download as PDF, XLS or CSV.
banks.note: We couldn't confirm CSV or Excel for savings accounts on the retail screen. Check the format menu.

banks.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
steps: Log in to Net Banking and go to Banking, then Savings/Current Account, then View/Download Account Statement.
Choose a yearly statement for the current or last financial or calendar year.
Download it as CSV.
banks.note: Yearly statements are CSV. Other periods can be emailed.
